items.label: Net margin
items.why: How much of each pound of sales becomes profit.

items.label: Return on equity
items.why: Profit generated on shareholders' money.

items.label: Revenue growth
items.why: Year-on-year sales growth (latest quarter).

items.label: Earnings growth
items.why: Year-on-year earnings growth (latest quarter).

items.label: Debt / equity
items.why: Lower means less reliance on borrowing.

items.label: Forward P/E
items.why: Price vs next year's expected earnings. Lower is cheaper.

items.label: Trailing P/E
items.why: Price vs the last 12 months' earnings. Scored against the sector median.

items.label: PEG
items.why: P/E divided by growth. Around 1 or below is good value for the growth.

items.label: EV / EBITDA
items.why: Whole-company value vs operating earnings.

items.label: Off 52-week high
items.why: Just below the high scores a little better than at it; a deeper fall earns no extra credit (our ten-year test found none).

items.label: Momentum (12-1 months)
items.why: Return from a year ago to a month ago. Strong past winners have tended to keep doing well.

items.label: vs 200-day
items.why: Close to or modestly below the long-term average is a calmer entry than far above it.

items.label: RSI (14)
items.why: Below ~40 is a cooled-off entry; above ~70 is stretched.

items.label: Upside to target
items.why: Analysts' average price target.

items.label: Analyst rating
items.why: 1 = strong buy, 3 = hold, 5 = sell.

signals.label: Pullback to 50-day
